calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) all_net, sum(case when f.staff_purchase_flag then 0 else f.net_amount end) nostaff, count(distinct f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-02' AND DATE '2025-06-08' AND f.channel_code='ST' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) n, sum(case when abs(r.net_sales_before_returns-f.all_net)<0.01 then 1 else 0 end) match_all, sum(case when abs(r.net_sales_before_returns-f.nostaff)<0.01 then 1 else 0 end) match_nostaff, sum(case when r.receipts=f.rc then 1 else 0 end) rc_match
FROM f JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id=f.store_id AND r.business_date=f.sale_date

WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag st, f.channel_code ch, p.subcategory FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND p.category='Garden'),
j AS (SELECT s.*, coalesce(r.qty,0) rq, coalesce(r.refund,0) rn, r.n rn_lines FROM s LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) qty, sum(refund_net) refund, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r USING (sales_line_id))
SELECT subcategory, sum(quantity) units, sum(rq) ret_units, round(100.0*sum(rq)/sum(quantity),2) unit_rate, sum(net_amount) net, sum(rn) refund_net, round(100.0*sum(rn)/sum(net_amount),2) val_rate,
 sum(case when rq>quantity then 1 else 0 end) over_ret, max(rn_lines) maxlines,
 round(100.0*sum(case when st then 0 else rq end)/sum(case when st then 0 else quantity end),2) unit_rate_nostaff,
 round(100.0*sum(case when ch='WB' then rq else 0 end)/sum(case when ch='WB' then quantity else 0 end),2) wb_rate,
 round(100.0*sum(case when ch='ST' then rq else 0 end)/sum(case when ch='ST' then quantity else 0 end),2) st_rate
FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'stg_ret' k, count(*) n, sum(case when exists(select 1 from fact_return_line r where r.return_line_id=g.return_line_id) then 1 else 0 end) in_fact, sum(case when exists(select 1 from fact_sales_line s where s.sales_line_id=g.sales_line_id and s.sale_date between DATE '2025-04-28' and DATE '2025-07-27') then 1 else 0 end) in_window, min(return_date) a, max(return_date) b FROM stg_return_line_load g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg_sales', count(*), sum(case when exists(select 1 from fact_sales_line r where r.sales_line_id=g.sales_line_id) then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when sale_date between DATE '2025-04-28' and DATE '2025-07-27' then 1 else 0 end), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM stg_sales_line_load g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_'||w.status, count(*), sum(case when s.sales_line_id is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0, min(order_ts_utc)::date, max(order_ts_utc)::date FROM fact_web_order w LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.receipt_id=w.web_order_id AND s.channel_code='WB' WHERE w.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-04-27' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-07-29' GROUP BY w.status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_before_sale', count(*), 0,0, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date < s.sale_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_prodkey_diff', count(*), 0,0, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product a ON a.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product b ON b.product_key=s.product_key WHERE a.sku<>b.sku OR a.subcategory<>b.subcategory

SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, (f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to) valid_at_sale, count(*) n, sum(f.quantity) units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND (p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM tmp_outdoor_lighting_skus) OR p.category='Garden' OR p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting')

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.subcategory, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27'
    AND p.category = 'Garden'),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, s.subcategory,
       round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY s.subcategory ORDER BY s.subcategory
